About us

A Kabul street-food classic, in the heart of G-9

Rustom Afghani Burger is an Afghani burger cafe in Karachi Company, G-9 Markaz, Islamabad, dedicated to one thing: the Afghani burger — the generous, wrap-style burger that made Kabul's street-food stalls famous.

Find us in G-9 Markaz, open every day from 11 in the morning until midnight — walk in, or call ahead and have your order ready.
